correctness.rationale: The orthonormal Laguerre basis and Laplace inner products yield J_W(t)=4N_W(t)/P_W(t)^2 on the full t>=0 domain. Independent SymPy expansion verified exactly J_W(W-1)=(W+1)/W, J_W(t)-(W+1)/W=-(t-W+1)^2H_W(t)/(W P_W(t)^2), the derivative -8(t-W+1)Q_W(t)/P_W(t)^3, and discriminant 16W(W-3). At W=3, J-4/3=-4(t-2)^2(t-5)^2/[3(t^2-4t+16)^2], giving both global carrier levels. For W>3 the negative region of H is a bounded interval t>W and strict convexity of Q there gives a unique maximum. The high-frequency substitution Q_W(W+u)=W(2u^2-8u+2)+u^3+2u^2+u proves the 2+sqrt(3) branch. Constraints on equal amplitudes, phase and omega>=2a are essential.
